title: Per-provider attribution schema defined and mechanically validated

predecessorGap.observed: single `provider` string, `providerRetries: "NOT_CAPTURED"`, no per-provider calls/bytes/wall-time breakdown, no transitions

contract.blendRefused: an empty provider list is YIELD_PROVIDER_ATTRIBUTION_MISSING
contract.duplicatesRefused: the same provider identity twice is YIELD_PROVIDER_ATTRIBUTION_DUPLICATE
contract.fieldwise: each numeric field is a MEASURED number/attribution or NOT_CAPTURED with a reason; a missing field is YIELD_PROVIDER_ATTRIBUTION_FIELD_MISSING
contract.transitions: transitionsIn/transitionsOut must be string arrays so a multi-provider run records its deterministic transition path
